kind: A (per-cell evaluation, single joint quota run, plan-order conflict resolution)
descriptive_only_rule: test cells with < 100 unique aircraft or < 150 accepted episodes
conditions: quotas count ACCEPTED episodes and accepted unique aircraft; accepted shortfall fails the run (or is reported) when fail_on_capacity_shortfall
pilot reports per-cell realized ACCEPTED counts after joint priority-order assignment and flags under-target cells
max 3 episodes per aircraft per cell
provenance records both the full-HDD train-split fingerprint (band p95 source) and the subset fingerprint
validator reports per-cell window strata (attacked/ambiguous/boundary/interior-only) and confirms interior-only is non-empty for 600/900 s cells
notes: altitude_constant_deviation is PROVISIONAL. Kind B tau=0.005 is an assumed prevalence, not calibrated.
